blocked.detail: ROBOTS-DISALLOWED FOR US, and this entry previously said verified:true. www.fivb.org/robots.txt names our crawler explicitly — 'User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: /' — alongside GPTBot, CCBot, Google-Extended and others, and the wildcard block carries a Content-Signal reservation of ai-train=no, use=reference. Re-read directly on 2026-07-25 to confirm rather than taking it second-hand. The endpoint itself works and its coverage was real (1530 indoor + 9256 beach tournaments; per-set points and set duration; no PlusLiga or Turkish leagues), which is exactly why the restriction matters: this was the primary source for BOTH indoor per-set markets and essentially all of beach volleyball, and there is no comparable free replacement for beach. Do not fetch it. Any use needs written permission from FIVB.

RICHEST FREE SOURCE (per-set + per-skill team/player stats for SuperLega, PlusLiga, many federations). Blocked by OUR egress proxy (502 to CONNECT), NOT by the site - www.dataproject.com returned 200. HIGHEST-VALUE RETEST from a GitHub Actions runner.

key_findings: COMPLIANCE CORRECTION 2026-07-25: FIVB is robots-disallowed for our crawler by name. It was the single best source here and is now off-limits, so the usable per-set sources are TVF, PlusLiga, legavolley and CEV - all national or continental, none global. Beach volleyball loses its only substantial free archive outright.
Per-set scores confirmed in TVF, PlusLiga, legavolley, CEV. Absent in TheSportsDB - which makes it unusable for the set-based markets that dominate volleyball.
The 5th set is played to 15, which compresses the favourite's edge to near coin-flip (~50-53%). Total-sets and correct-set-score need a rally-level simulator, not a match-win probability.
Total sets O/U 3.5 is a function of the strength GAP, not team quality: evenly matched strong teams go long, a mismatch ends 3-0. Never feed it raw team ratings.
Side-out % is the master metric (65-72% in top leagues); break-point % is the scarcer skill that separates title teams.
Setter absence is the highest-leverage single injury, then opposite, then libero.
Home advantage is large: 55-62% in European leagues, higher in TUR/POL/BRA arenas.
Beach volleyball shares market names but nothing else - best-of-3, sets to 21, no rotation/libero stats, big wind effects. Separate model entirely.
